name: Magis Sparkmantle
summary: In Kharanos, Magis Sparkmantle teaches gnome mages inside the Thunderbrew Distillery. He guides new spellcasters who come from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh.

sections.title: A Spellcaster in the Distillery
sections.body: Dwarves come to the Thunderbrew Distillery for ale, and Magis Sparkmantle teaches among its casks and kegs. Across Dun Morogh, gnome mages work closely with their dwarven allies. Magis helps new spellcasters deepen their knowledge of the arcane and put it to practice.

sections.title: Directing Young Arcanists
sections.body: Magis teaches beginners their first incantations, then points promising students toward broader studies of magic. When they outgrow his early lessons or need special guidance, he sends them to other practitioners, including Bink, or to mentors in the Alliance’s main hubs.

faq.answer: Magis Sparkmantle trains gnome mages in Kharanos and teaches novice spellcasters the fundamentals of the arcane.

faq.q: Where can Magis Sparkmantle be found?
faq.answer: You can find Magis inside the Thunderbrew Distillery, Kharanos’s main inn and gathering hall.

faq.q: Why is a gnome mage trainer staying in a dwarven distillery?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, many gnomes settled among their dwarven cousins in Dun Morogh. The Thunderbrew Distillery is Kharanos’s central gathering place, so Magis can guide spellcasters who travel through.

faq.q: Does Magis Sparkmantle offer any quests?
faq.answer: Magis sends developing mages to other arcane mentors as their studies advance, including Bink and instructors in human territories.

angles.text: As an Alliance mage traveling through Dun Morogh, you can turn to Magis for spell training and introductions to broader arcane studies.
As a gnome living among the dwarves, you can look to mentors like Magis to keep your scholarly and arcane traditions alive.
